iOS_Evidence: CallReviewView.samplesCard lets a rep add a product+qty to a call (Views/CLMViews.swift:818-881), but with no lot concept and an eligibility check limited to a hardcoded 3-product yearly cap that is UI-advisory only (02_inventory_ios.md §5.1/§11).
Risk_Notes: iOS side needs real eligibility parity with the server (lot/expiry/cold-chain/limit checks), not just a display-only cap.

Requirement_Summary: Single hub: on-hand by lot, Pending Sample Receipts, Sample Inventories, New Transfer/Return/Adjustment/Inventory, View Transactions, Inventory Orders, Allocations.

iOS_Evidence: No such hub screen exists; HomeView's dashboard has no sample section (02_inventory_ios.md §5.2, full screen table has no My Samples entry).

Requirement_Summary: On-behalf-of lookup when Enable_My_Samples_Login=true.

Requirement_Summary: Disbursement transactions are never created manually; only via Call submit (or save, per config).
SF_Evidence: SampleDropService.createTransactions() is the only code path that inserts Transaction_Type__c='Disbursement' rows, triggered from Sample_Drop__c afterInsert / Call_Visit_Report__c afterCallSubmit (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleDropService.cls:79-186). However nothing in SampleTransactionService.beforeSave rejects a manually-inserted Disbursement row not linked to a Sample_Drop__c, so the rule is convention/permission-enforced, not Apex-hard-enforced.
iOS_Evidence: Samples are always entered as part of a CVR via CallReviewView; there is no standalone 'create disbursement' screen (02_inventory_ios.md §5.1/§5.2).
Risk_Notes: A validation rule on Sample_Transaction__c (reject a Disbursement insert with no Sample_Drop__c link) would close the theoretical hole and make SM-MYS-04 fully enforced rather than convention-based.

Requirement_Summary: Fields: Sample product, Lot_Number, Expiration_Date (nullable), Active, Calculated_Quantity (running on-hand, never user-editable), Batch_Lot_Id (case-sensitive), Is_Virtual_Lot, U_M, owner.
SF_Evidence: Sample_Lot__c has Product__c, Lot_Number__c, Expiry_Date__c, Status__c (Active/Depleted/Expired/Recalled/Quarantined -- richer than a boolean), Owner_User__c, and Available_Quantity__c maintained only by force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:292-297 (matching 'never user-editable': the Sciagen_Mobile_App_Access permission set grants Sample_Lot__c Read-only, 01_inventory_salesforce.md §12.3). Is_Virtual_Lot__c and U_M__c fields do not exist (confirmed absent from the 21-field list); Batch_Lot_Id__c's case-sensitivity is UNVERIFIED from metadata alone.
iOS_Evidence: No Lot concept anywhere in the client.
Risk_Notes: None blocking.

Requirement_Summary: Admin-owned lots are the master lot catalog (importable from ERP); no 'initial quantity' field on a lot -- quantity only enters via Receipt/Transfer.
SF_Evidence: Sample_Lot__c has an Initial_Quantity__c field with its own validation rule Initial_Quantity_Positive (force-app/main/default/objects/Sample_Lot__c/validationRules/), directly contradicting the spec's explicit 'no initial quantity field on a lot' requirement; quantity can be set directly at lot creation, not solely via Receipt/Transfer transactions.
iOS_Evidence: No lot creation surface exists client-side at all.
Risk_Notes: Removing/repurposing Initial_Quantity__c is a schema change; Sample_Lot__c has 0 org records today (01_inventory_salesforce.md §11) so data-migration risk in this sandbox is low, but it would be a breaking change if any admin process already relies on setting it directly.

Requirement_Summary: Sample_Lot_Item__c child, record type TagAlert, for cold-chain tag alert numbers.
SF_Evidence: No Sample_Lot_Item__c object exists (`find objects -iname *Sample_Lot_Item*` empty); cold-chain tag numbers instead live as a single Cold_Chain_Tag_Number__c text field directly on Sample_Lot__c/Sample_Transaction__c, with no multi-value child list of known tag numbers per lot.

Requirement_Summary: A lot becomes Active for a user when they confirm receipt, subject to Enable_Receipt_Activation.
SF_Evidence: landTransfersIn() (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:340-385) always creates/activates the recipient's lot as Status__c='Active' on Transfer_In confirmation, with no Enable_Receipt_Activation toggle (see SM-CFG-03) to make activation immediate-on-transfer instead.
Risk_Notes: None blocking.

Requirement_Summary: Best practice: use lookup fields for internal rep-to-rep transfers; use text fields only for parties outside the system.
SF_Evidence: Sample_Transaction__c has only lookup fields From_User__c/To_User__c/From_Warehouse__c/To_Warehouse__c; there are no matching Transferred_From_Name__c/Transferred_To_Name__c free-text fields for parties outside the system (confirmed absent from all 57 fields), so the 'outside the system' half of this requirement cannot currently be captured at all. There is also no Custom Label/help-text infrastructure to hold guidance text (no Custom Labels exist org-wide, 01_inventory_salesforce.md §6.3).
iOS_Evidence: No transaction/transfer concept exists client-side to carry this guidance.
Risk_Notes: None blocking; straightforward field addition once Custom Labels infra exists (see SM-CFG-08).

Requirement_Summary: From-user's lot Calculated_Quantity decremented immediately on submit; cannot go below zero.
SF_Evidence: force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:193-196 (Transfer_Out, Status='Completed'): blocks if qty > available (line 194: 'Only N packs are available...'); effect=-qty.
iOS_Evidence: No Transfer concept exists in the iOS client.
Risk_Notes: SF logic is solid; iOS build is the real effort (see SM-SETUP-05).

Requirement_Summary: To-user gets a Pending Sample Receipt; the new lot is activated on confirmation (per SM-CFG-03).
SF_Evidence: createTransfersIn() (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:323-338) automatically creates a Transfer_In row with Status='Pending' once Transfer_Out completes, and landTransfersIn() activates the lot on Confirmed/Completed -- but there is no Enable_Receipt_Activation config to alter this behavior (see SM-CFG-03/SM-LOT-04).
Risk_Notes: None blocking.

Requirement_Summary: Ship-to address auto-fills from recipient's Rep Roster (via Username External ID); block with a clear message if none found.
SF_Evidence: Rep_Roster__c does not exist (see SM-RR-01); no ship-address fields exist on Sample_Transaction__c at all (57 fields enumerated, none are address fields), and no such validation/block message exists.

Requirement_Summary: Transferring to someone outside the system uses Transferred_To_Name__c (text).
SF_Evidence: See SM-TXN-01; the field does not exist.
Risk_Notes: Same fix as SM-TXN-01.

Requirement_Summary: Batch Lot ID carry-over: match on Lot#+Sample+Owner(recipient); no match -> create with the transferred lot's Batch Lot ID; match -> overwrite.
SF_Evidence: Precisely implemented in force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:340-385 (landTransfersIn): matches on SampleLotService.keyFor(Product+Owner_User(recipient)+Lot_Number) (lines 350,362); overwrites Batch_Lot_Id__c on a match (line 367: `if (!String.isBlank(src.Batch_Lot_Id__c)) upd.Batch_Lot_Id__c = src.Batch_Lot_Id__c;`); creates a new lot carrying the source's Batch_Lot_Id__c when no match exists (line 372).
Risk_Notes: One of the most faithfully-implemented requirements in the entire module -- a strong reuse candidate, flagged as a highlight.

Requirement_Summary: Cold-chain products require Tag Alert # and/or Cold Chain Status at transfer.
SF_Evidence: force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:160-163: `cold && !coldChainComplete(r)` blocks Transfer_Out until both fields are set.

Requirement_Summary: Custom text capturable at transfer.
SF_Evidence: Custom_Text__c exists on Sample_Transaction__c and is copied through to the created Transfer_In row (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:331); no UI was confirmed to actually expose it for entry (no 'My Samples' transfer form found, see SM-MYS-01).
Risk_Notes: Field-level support exists; UI is the gap.

Requirement_Summary: Sample_Receipt__c created for the recipient on Transfer submit or integrated shipment; shows in Pending Sample Receipts; discrepancy flag.
SF_Evidence: No separate Sample_Receipt__c object exists (confirmed absent); this role is instead played by a Sample_Transaction__c row of Transaction_Type__c='Transfer_In' with Status='Pending' (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:323-338) -- a single-ledger-object pattern rather than the spec's dedicated Receipt object. No discrepancy-flag field exists (Inventory_Shortfall__c is computed for Disbursement shortfalls, not receipt-quantity discrepancies), and no 'Pending Sample Receipts' list view/screen was confirmed.
Risk_Notes: Reusing Transfer_In-as-Receipt is workable but the discrepancy-flag/notification gap (SM-RCP-02) needs to be closed regardless of which shape is kept.

Requirement_Summary: Confirm with Confirmed Qty (default per SM-CFG-01); mismatch requires a discrepancy reason and notifies Sample Admin; inventory updated by confirmed qty.
SF_Evidence: Confirmed_Quantity__c exists and is correctly used as the applied stock effect on Receipt/Transfer_In confirmation (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:192,200: `effect = r.Confirmed_Quantity__c != null ? r.Confirmed_Quantity__c : qty`), but there is no discrepancy-reason requirement or Sample-Admin notification when Confirmed_Quantity__c differs from the expected quantity -- the notify* methods in afterSave() only cover Returns/large Adjustments/breaches/shortfalls, not receipt discrepancies.
Risk_Notes: None blocking; discrepancy handling is the concrete gap to close.

Requirement_Summary: Receipts may originate from integration (warehouse/ERP/third-party sampling system) with Transferred_From_Name__c = distribution centre.
SF_Evidence: No inbound integration endpoint exists for receipts (no Named Credentials/HttpRequest-based integration classes found anywhere, 01_inventory_salesforce.md §9), and no Transferred_From_Name__c text field exists (see SM-TXN-01).

Risk_Notes: Would be the org's first real outbound/inbound integration surface for samples.

Requirement_Summary: Cold chain + custom text capturable at receipt.
SF_Evidence: Cold-chain completeness is required before a Receipt/Transfer_In can be confirmed (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:190,198: 'enter the tag number and status when confirming the receipt/transfer'), and Custom_Text__c exists on the same object.
Risk_Notes: None.

Requirement_Summary: After confirming, prompt the user to submit an inventory count (best practice nudge).
SF_Evidence: No Sample_Inventory__c object exists at all (confirmed absent by directory search), so no such prompt/workflow can exist.
Risk_Notes: Depends on an Inventory-count feature (SM-INV, outside this slice's ID list) that is entirely unbuilt.

Requirement_Summary: My Samples -> New Return; Return_To picklist admin-configurable; a Rep Roster record must exist for each Return-To value (validated).
SF_Evidence: Return_To__c is a plain free-Text field (100 chars, no picklist, no validation rule) -- force-app/main/default/objects/Sample_Transaction__c/fields/Return_To__c.field-meta.xml -- and since Rep_Roster__c doesn't exist there is no way to validate a Return-To value against a real destination record at all.
iOS_Evidence: No Return transaction type exists in the client.
Risk_Notes: Depends on SM-RR-01/04.

Requirement_Summary: Reason (damaged/expired/recalled/termination/excess/other); decrements lot qty; cold chain + custom text capturable.
SF_Evidence: Return_Reason__c exists as a picklist (values not read at this pass) with an enforcing validation rule Return_Needs_Reason (01_inventory_salesforce.md §5.6); Return effect correctly decrements the lot (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:204-207, blocked if qty>available); cold-chain fields are checked and a Return to a warehouse without cold storage is explicitly blocked (lines 167-169) -- stricter than the spec requires. Custom_Text__c exists generically on the object.
Risk_Notes: None blocking.

Requirement_Summary: Expired and recalled lots: bulk 'Return all' action.

Requirement_Summary: My Samples -> New Adjustment; adjusts Calculated_Quantity by a signed quantity (e.g. -1 to reduce by 1); help text makes sign convention unmistakable.
SF_Evidence: force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:208-211 (Adjustment, Status='Completed'): `effect = qty` directly -- a signed quantity is added to Available_Quantity__c, matching the spec's convention exactly; blocked if it would go negative. No Custom Label/help text exists to explain the sign convention to end users (no Custom Labels org-wide).
iOS_Evidence: No Adjustment concept exists in the client.
Risk_Notes: Logic is correct; only user-facing help text (blocked on SM-CFG-08) is missing.

Requirement_Summary: Reason picklist (lost/stolen/damaged/data-entry error/count variance/other), admin-modifiable; theft/loss triggers a Sample Admin alert (+ US pack significant-loss workflow).
SF_Evidence: Adjustment_Reason__c picklist exists with values Loss/Damage/Expired/Recount/Correction/Other (not an exact match to the spec list -- no distinct 'Stolen' or 'Data-entry error' value, and 'Expired' is an odd fit for an adjustment). notifyLargeAdjustments() only alerts managers when an adjustment exceeds 10% of the lot's initial quantity, not specifically for a Loss reason regardless of size, and there is no significant-loss report workflow for the US pack.
Risk_Notes: None blocking.

Requirement_Summary: Adjustments above a configurable threshold require manager/admin approval (Salesforce Approval Process).
SF_Evidence: Requires_Approval__c/Approved_By__c/Approved_At__c fields exist and are enforced by a hand-rolled Apex gate (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:130-135: blocks a Pending->Completed transition unless the user holds Manage_Sample_Inventory) -- not a declarative Salesforce Approval Process (no `approvalProcesses/` directory exists anywhere in the org, confirmed absent org-wide, 01_inventory_salesforce.md §5.4). No configurable dollar/quantity threshold auto-sets Requires_Approval__c.
Risk_Notes: Same custom-gate-vs-declarative-Approval-Process pattern noted for SM-CFG-24/SM-UNL; worth a single design decision for the whole module.

Requirement_Summary: Cold chain + custom text capturable at adjustment.
SF_Evidence: Cold_Chain_Tag_Number__c/Cold_Chain_Status__c/Custom_Text__c fields exist generically on Sample_Transaction__c, but the Adjustment branch of validateAndDecide() (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:173-175) does not call coldChainComplete() the way Disbursement/Transfer_Out/Return/Receipt do -- cold-chain capture is not actually enforced for Adjustments even though the fields exist.
Risk_Notes: Small, well-scoped fix (add the same coldChainComplete() check already used for the other four transaction types).

Requirement_Summary: If a rep submits a signed call with the wrong lot/qty, only a Sample Admin can unlock it (reason required, audit-logged).
SF_Evidence: Unlock capability exists (force-app/main/default/classes/SupportUnlockService.cls:33-55) but is gated by isAgent() + the Support_Unlock_Calls custom permission -- a Support-desk agent role via the Support_Request__c ticketing system -- not the Sciagen_Sample_Admin permission set/Manage_Sample_Inventory permission the spec's 'Sample Admin' role implies: a different actor model than specified. A reason is required to decline() but is optional (defaults to a canned message) to unlock() (lines 33-42). Audit logging exists via Unlocked_At__c/Unlocked_By__c/Unlock_Count__c on Call_Visit_Report__c plus a Support_Comment__c trail.
iOS_Evidence: No unlock screen/flow exists in the iPad client.
Risk_Notes: Actor-model mismatch (Support agent vs Sample Admin) is a design decision to resolve before extending.

Requirement_Summary: Behaviour follows Unlock_Call_Policy: (a) reopen + require second HCP signature, or (b) leave locked + require a linked Adjustment, or (c) both allowed; compliance note shown in admin UI.
SF_Evidence: unlock() always reopens the entire call to 'Saved' status for full re-edit (force-app/main/default/classes/SupportUnlockService.cls:44-49) and beforeCallUpdate() only forces a fresh signature specifically for controlled-substance lines (force-app/main/default/classes/SampleDropService.cls:170-173); there is no configurable policy choice, no 'Adjustment Only' path that leaves the call locked, and no compliance-note UI text found. This is a single hardcoded behavior, not the spec's 3-way configurable policy.
iOS_Evidence: No unlock screen/flow exists in the iPad client.
Risk_Notes: Depends on SM-CFG-24 (same gap, PARTIAL there because the fields exist but not the policy engine).

Requirement_Summary: Unlock reverses and re-posts ledger entries; never edits history in place.
SF_Evidence: Confirmed by reading both classes end-to-end: force-app/main/default/classes/SupportUnlockService.cls.unlock() only flips Call_Visit_Report__c.Record_Status__c back to 'Saved' -- it never touches any Sample_Transaction__c or Sample_Drop__c record. force-app/main/default/classes/SampleDropService.cls's createTransactions()/afterCallSubmit() only process a Sample_Drop__c whose Transaction__c is still null (line 184: `WHERE ... AND Transaction__c = null`) -- an existing drop line edited after unlock (same Id, Transaction__c already set) is never re-processed, so its already-posted Disbursement transaction is neither reversed nor re-posted, leaving the ledger and on-hand quantity silently out of sync with the corrected call. There is also no append-only Sample_Ledger_Entry__c object at all (confirmed absent) -- Sample_Transaction__c itself is directly mutable, not an immutable ledger.
Risk_Notes: HIGHEST-SEVERITY inventory-integrity finding in this slice -- directly relevant to the audit's high-risk area #1 (see gap_notes_part1.md). A rep can unlock, silently edit an already-disbursed sample line's quantity/lot, and resubmit without the ledger ever being corrected.
